run_multiple_training_runs: run the shaDow training script multiple times with repeated configurations and collect statistics
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for dataset, configs, gpu, repetition, and caching options
execute_subprocess_training: execute the shaDow main module as a subprocess and stream stdout line by line
collect_training_statistics: collect train, valid, and test metrics from FINAL SUMMARY output lines across multiple runs
compute_metric_summary: compute mean and standard deviation of collected metrics across all training repetitions
